svg.title: Scope, lifetime and physical storage are separate questions
svg.text: Scope, lifetime and physical storage are separate questions
Live values consume register units; compiler allocation and rounding govern the resource cost.
Thread-private local memory → device backing and caches
Local means private scope. Local accesses alone do not identify register spills.
All required producers and consumers coordinate; contents do not persist across block invocations.
More registers can reduce residency; a tighter register ceiling can add spill or recomputation work.
Global input/output allocations remain protected until device last use is known to have completed.
